title: The 5 Fastest Trains Ever, Ranked (#1 Doesn't Touch the Track)

scenes.text: The five fastest trains ever recorded. Number one doesn't touch the track.

scenes.label: Transrapid · 311 mph
scenes.text: Number five: China's Transrapid maglev, tested in 2003. Five hundred one kilometers an hour, about 311 miles an hour.

scenes.label: TGV Atlantique · 320 mph
scenes.text: Number four: France's TGV Atlantique, in 1990. Five hundred fifteen kilometers an hour, about 320 miles an hour.

scenes.label: TGV POS · 357 mph
scenes.text: Number three: the French TGV, in 2007. Five hundred seventy-five kilometers an hour, the fastest ever on steel wheels.

scenes.label: MLX01 · 361 mph
scenes.text: Number two: Japan's MLX01 maglev, in 2003. Five hundred eighty-one kilometers an hour, about 361 miles an hour.

scenes.label: L0 maglev · 375 mph
scenes.text: Number one: Japan's L0 maglev, in 2015. Six hundred three kilometers an hour, 375 miles an hour, floating on magnets above the track.

description:
The five fastest trains ever recorded, ranked by their top test speed.
The winner hit 603 kilometers an hour in 2015, and the fastest train on wheels only comes third.
Which of these would you ride?
first_comment: Would you ride a train at 375 miles an hour? And what should we rank next?
